story-context.story-title: Instrument Memory, Profile, and LLM Phases
story-context.summary: Add status emissions for memory operations, profile loading, and LLM composition phases to provide users with visibility into the full processing pipeline. This builds on the status emitter infrastructure from Story 11.1 and adds instrumentation for operations that occur before and during LLM streaming.

criterion.title: Memory Operations
criterion.description: - Retrieval: "🔍 Retrieving your memories..." - Retrieval complete: "✅ Found 3 relevant memories" (or "No relevant memories found") - Storage: "💾 Saving conversation to memory..." - Storage complete: "✅ Memory saved" - Background operations should be silent (no status for background refresh)

criterion.title: Profile Operations
criterion.description: - Load: "👤 Loading your profile..." - Load complete: "✅ Profile loaded (67% complete)" - Background refresh: Silent (no status emission) - Cache hit: Silent (no status - too fast to show)

criterion.title: LLM Phases
criterion.description: - Just before streaming: "🧠 Composing response..." - Emitted after all tool calls complete, before first token - Marks transition from "gathering info" to "generating answer"

criterion.title: Grok Live Search (if applicable)
criterion.description: - Search triggered: "🌐 Searching the web..." - Search complete: "✅ Found {n} sources" - Only emit if Grok Live Search is actually invoked

file.purpose: Add status emissions for profile loading operations

key-functions.function: Current: Silent cache hit/miss, returns immediately (<10ms) Add: emit_status() ONLY on cache miss before MCP call Skip: Cache hits (too fast), background refresh
Current: Background task with @observe trace Add: NO STATUS - this is background operation, should be silent

file.notes: Profile cache hits are <10ms - too fast to show status. Only emit status on cache miss when fetching from service. Background refresh must be silent to avoid confusing user.

file.purpose: Add LLM composition phase status and coordinate profile/memory status

key-functions.function: Current: Tool orchestration loop, LLM streaming Add: emit_status("🧠 Composing response...") just before streaming starts Location: After tool calls complete, before llm_client.stream_chat_completion() Lines: ~315 (OpenAI/Grok), ~148 (Gemini) - before streaming
Current: Loads profile from cache, builds system prompt Add: Check if profile_manager.load_profile_from_cache() was cache miss Consider: Pass status context to profile/memory operations

file.notes: LLM composition status marks transition from "gathering" to "generating". Profile loading happens at line ~804-824 - need to coordinate with profile.py. Memory retrieval likely happens in chat endpoint - check routes/chat.py.

implementation-notes.note: emit_status() function must be imported from backend/api/status.py Example: from api.status import emit_status
Status emissions should only occur when operations take >100ms. Profile cache hits (<10ms) should skip status emissions.
Memory retrieval call site needs to be identified (likely in routes/chat.py or stream.py). Search for memory_client.retrieve_memories() calls.
For Grok Live Search detection, check if llm_client response metadata includes live_search_sources_used field. May defer to future story if complex.
Background operations (profile refresh, memory retry worker) must remain silent - they happen async and would confuse users.

test-case.name: Memory retrieval status
test-case.steps: 1. Trigger memory retrieval with query 2. Verify "🔍 Retrieving your memories..." emitted 3. Verify completion status with count or "No relevant memories found"

test-case.name: Memory storage status
test-case.steps: 1. Trigger conversation storage 2. Verify "💾 Saving conversation to memory..." emitted 3. Verify "✅ Memory saved" on success

test-case.name: Profile cache hit - no status
test-case.steps: 1. Load profile with warm cache 2. Verify NO status emitted (too fast)

test-case.name: LLM composition phase
test-case.steps: 1. Complete all tool calls 2. Verify "🧠 Composing response..." emitted before first token 3. Verify timing: after tools, before streaming
